scene_full.prompt: Bright, airy, light-filled photorealistic interior photograph of a kitchen in a classic Cincinnati Victorian home with tall windows, open-plan kitchen with long island and full-height slab backsplash. The hero is the countertop: Calacatta Andromeda quartz (bright white quartz with soft light-grey branching veins, matching the reference slab photo), 3cm thick with a clean eased edge, shown in full with no cropped ends or corners. Greige painted shaker cabinets with brushed brass hardware, bright natural light from a skylight and tall windows. Light walls, clean bright exposure, fresh and stunning, styled minimally (a bowl of lemons, a small vase of greenery, a cutting board), uncluttered, real materials and true-to-life reflections, eye-level architectural photography, 24-35mm lens, magazine quality. Tall vertical 9:16 composition: the countertop sits in the vertical middle of the frame and spans no more than 85% of the width, with generous ceiling/upper cabinets above and floor below, so the image can also be cropped to 4:5 and 1:1 around the countertop. Quiet, low-detail upper corners (plain wall or ceiling). No people, no text, no logos, no watermarks.
